name: nyc-yellow-taxi
title: NYC TLC yellow taxi trips, January 2026
description: Every yellow taxi trip the New York City Taxi and Limousine Commission recorded as picked up in January 2026, from the TLC's own monthly file: when each trip began, its hour and day of the week, its distance, whether it began at one of the three airports, and whether its record is complete. LICENCE: the TLC publishes the files as open data and its data page declares no licence for them, so none is asserted here. Demo data: referenced by pinned URL and built locally. Meridian does not host or publish this dataset.

sources.title: NYC Taxi and Limousine Commission, TLC Trip Record Data, yellow taxi trips, January 2026

pickup_time.description: When the meter was engaged, in New York local time as the TLC records it.

weekday.description: The day of the week of pickup_time, as its ISO number and short name, so '1 Mon' sorts before '7 Sun'.

trip_miles.description: The trip's distance as the taximeter reported it, in miles, capped at 30 so a few implausible distances do not set a chart's scale.

pickup_place.description: JFK Airport, LaGuardia Airport or Newark Airport when the trip began in that taxi zone, and elsewhere otherwise.

trip_record.description: complete, or the first of negative fare, zero distance and no passenger count that applies to the record.
